unclear: The conversion and result pass too quickly to explain how the listed skills relate to the original GitHub work.

product_clear_basis: GitHub address changes to skillsgithub.com before interests and expertise appear.

lessons.keep: Give a product action a clear trigger through an incoming request.
try: For a portfolio launch, hold one repository beside its extracted skill for two seconds before showing the final profile.
Try a matched return to the opening building or desk after the message sends, using one restrained brand detail in that same environment.
lessons.avoid: Avoid changing account evidence or cropping away the source behind a skill claim.
lessons.open: Footage origin, skills accuracy, live updates, sent content and all audio remain unverified.
